name: tl_f2_lora_sequential
title: The same two corpora through a single LoRA adapter, in sequence
caption: A single adapter learns language 1 (4.35 to 2.22 nats), then learning language 2 pushes language 1 to 6.00 nats, worse than before it was ever taught. English is untouched: the damage is between the two taught skills.
alt: Line chart with three points per line (base, after language 1, after language 2): language 1 falls then rises above its starting value; language 2 rises then falls; the English control stays flat near 3.
